about.title: Shopping that feels closer.
about.content: Samexxa is a modern marketplace concept connecting shoppers, neighbourhood businesses and trusted sellers. We bring discovery, promotions and everyday shopping together with a simple, human-first experience.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.content: These Terms & Conditions govern use of the Samexxa website and marketplace experience. By using the service, you agree to use it lawfully, provide accurate information and respect seller and platform policies. Product, seller, pricing, delivery and promotional information may change.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: Samexxa respects your privacy. Information submitted through forms or account experiences should be used only to provide requested services, support, communication and platform improvements. Production deployments should connect this content to the same privacy CMS and controls used by the mobile application.

refund.title: Return & Refund Policy
refund.content: Return and refund eligibility depends on the product, seller and applicable marketplace rules. Customers should review product-specific conditions before completing a purchase and contact support promptly when an order has an issue. The production policy should be synchronized with the app CMS.
